title: Brad Gerstner says Altimeter is aiming to invest $5B in Anthropic's IPO, 5x his largest IPO investment, calling it "a cornerstone compounder for a long time" (Kif Leswing/CNBC)
summary: Kif Leswing / CNBC: Brad Gerstner says Altimeter is aiming to invest $5B in Anthropic's IPO, 5x his largest IPO investment, calling it “a cornerstone compounder for a long time” — Altimeter Capital is aiming to invest $5 billion in the Anthropic IPO, Brad Gerstner told CNBC's “Halftime Report” on Monday.
contentText:
Kif Leswing / CNBC :

Brad Gerstner says Altimeter is aiming to invest $5B in Anthropic's IPO, 5x his largest IPO investment, calling it “a cornerstone compounder for a long time”   —  Altimeter Capital is aiming to invest $5 billion in the Anthropic IPO, Brad Gerstner told CNBC's “Halftime Report” on Monday.
